obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived scoped relation; finite observations do not establish a general proof.
obernants.assumptions: Native evidence is finite and revision-specific; ragged/nonfinite matrices, malformed partitions, numerical overflow and linguistic annotation quality are not newly established. Thresholds/caps and scratch reset semantics must match merged source. Integer objective equality does not imply assignment-vector equality under ties or equivalence on arbitrary fractional matrices. Real-arithmetic assignment optimality is a model target; general floating-point optimality is not established.
obernants.domain: Finite well-formed mention spans with fixed Head or Exact policy and stable input order; matching keys partition work into independent groups. Assignment comparisons use rectangular finite matrices; cross-implementation integer observations additionally require exact representability and safe negation/conversion. Empty and negative rectangular cases are tagged separately.
obernants.observation_scope: The actual scoring pipeline joins mention identities to metric partition IDs. Greedy mention matching and global maximum assignment are distinct operations within the score module; replacing one with the other is invalid. Harness observations independently compare heap-sort total keys with stable greedy identities and compare integer maximum objectives with a negated-cost minimum-assignment oracle only on exactly representable integer matrices. No runtime call from match_mentions to Hungarian is introduced.
obernants.operator: In U of tagged lawful matcher calls and complete output vectors, excluded observations include two predictions consuming one gold mention, a residual overlap pair displacing an available exact-span match, a zero-overlap residual pair being omitted while both sides remain free, and swapping equal-overlap ties against prediction/gold order. In the separate real-arithmetic assignment model, an objective below the maximum is excluded. For machine arithmetic, this epoch establishes preservation of the existing rounded observation and bounded exact-integer oracle results, not universal numerical optimality. Neither statement imposes maximum weight on greedy mention matching.

This rejected replacement is part of the model, even though assign_max is a legitimate separate metric component. Integer negation joins maximum and minimum assignment objectives only under exact numeric and rectangular shape obligations.

obernants.operator: Hungarian scratch minima and visited flags must be reset at every augmentation; potentials and the partial matching retain their intended state. Reusing buffers without this split can leak a previous search into the next. Empty, rectangular/transposed, negative and repeated-call observations constrain this seam; no allocation-count or runtime gain is asserted without measurements.
